title: Fuel and stint strategy
description: Fuel and stint strategy — provisioned openlaps endurance operations dashboard.

list.name: vehicle
list.label: Vehicle
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT vehicle_id AS __text, vehicle_id AS __value FROM v_samples_named WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT vehicle_id AS __text, vehicle_id AS __value FROM v_samples_named WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY 1

list.name: session
list.label: Session
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(session_id::text, 'unattributed') AS __text, COALESCE(session_id::text, 'unattributed') AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(session_id::text, 'unattributed') AS __text, COALESCE(session_id::text, 'unattributed') AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) ORDER BY 1

list.name: driver
list.label: Driver
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT driver AS __text, driver AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND driver IS NOT NULL AND ('$session' = 'all' OR session_id::text = '$session') AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT driver AS __text, driver AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND driver IS NOT NULL AND ('$session' = 'all' OR session_id::text = '$session') AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) ORDER BY 1

list.name: stint
list.label: Stint
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT concat('Stint ', stint_number, ' — ', COALESCE(driver, 'unattributed')) AS __text, stint_number::text AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE '$session' <> 'all' AND session_id::text = '$session' AND stint_number IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT concat('Stint ', stint_number, ' — ', COALESCE(driver, 'unattributed')) AS __text, stint_number::text AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE '$session' <> 'all' AND session_id::text = '$session' AND stint_number IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

list.name: lap
list.label: Lap
list.definition: SELECT concat('Lap ', lap_number, ' — ', COALESCE(driver, 'unattributed'), ' — ', to_char(crossed_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AS __text, lap_id::text AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND ('$session' = 'all' OR session_id::text = '$session') AND ('$driver' = 'all' OR driver = '$driver') AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) ORDER BY crossed_at
list.query: SELECT concat('Lap ', lap_number, ' — ', COALESCE(driver, 'unattributed'), ' — ', to_char(crossed_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AS __text, lap_id::text AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND ('$session' = 'all' OR session_id::text = '$session') AND ('$driver' = 'all' OR driver = '$driver') AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) ORDER BY crossed_at

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Every rule in the openlaps folder that is firing right now, wherever you are looking. Acknowledge on the annunciator (notifier, port 8086); this strip shows, it does not silence.

panels.title: Fuel used per lap and rolling five-lap mean

targets.rawSql: SELECT crossed_at AS time, fuel_used_l AS "Fuel used per lap", avg(fuel_used_l) OVER (ORDER BY crossed_at ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "Rolling five-lap mean" FROM v_lap_fuel WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) AND ('$session' = 'all' OR session_id::text = '$session') AND measurement_status = 'clean' ORDER BY crossed_at

panels.description: Counter-reset laps are gaps, never negative spikes; uncertainty is visible through the rolling sample count.

panels.title: Fuel level cross-check and counter divergence

targets.rawSql: SELECT started AS time, level_start_l AS "Fuel level start cross-check", level_end_l AS "Fuel level end cross-check", level_used_l - COALESCE((SELECT sum(fuel_used_l) FROM v_lap_fuel lf WHERE lf.vehicle_id = sf.vehicle_id AND lf.session_id = sf.session_id AND lf.stint_number = sf.stint_number AND lf.measurement_status = 'clean'), 0.0) AS "Level vs counter divergence" FROM v_stint_fuel_level sf WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND $__timeFilter(started) AND ('$session' = 'all' OR session_id::text = '$session') ORDER BY started

panels.description: The slow-smoothed level sender is a cross-check. It re-bases only after a refuel; fuel temperature correction is not included.

panels.title: Laps and dry-time projection

targets.rawSql: SELECT crossed_at AS time, CASE WHEN fuel_used_l > 0 THEN (SELECT level_end_l FROM v_stint_fuel_level sf WHERE sf.session_id = lf.session_id AND sf.stint_number = lf.stint_number) / fuel_used_l END AS "Laps remaining", CASE WHEN fuel_used_l > 0 THEN (SELECT level_end_l FROM v_stint_fuel_level sf WHERE sf.session_id = lf.session_id AND sf.stint_number = lf.stint_number) / fuel_used_l * lap_time_s END AS "Projected dry time", lap_time_s AS "Target lap time to window" FROM v_lap_fuel lf WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) AND measurement_status = 'clean' ORDER BY crossed_at

panels.description: Projected dry time, stint clock, and planned window belong on one time axis; fewer clean laps means lower confidence.

panels.title: Refuelling legal release clock

targets.rawSql: SELECT entry_at AS time, duration_s AS "Refuel elapsed", greatest(480.0 - duration_s, 0.0) AS "Time to 8-minute minimum", extract(epoch FROM entry_at + interval '8 minutes') AS "Legal release wall time" FROM v_pit_stops WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND stop_type = 'refuel' AND $__timeFilter(entry_at) ORDER BY entry_at

panels.description: Refuelling has an 8-minute legal minimum. Elapsed, remaining, and release wall time are deliberately distinct.

options.content: Counter reset laps are omitted, not treated as zero burn. `car.fuel_level` is the **cross-check** except at a post-refuel re-base. Compare the fuel window, stint clock, driving-time rules, and in/out-lap cost before radioing a target.
